what: Illustrator reports that 2025 was "pretty difficult" and they "still haven't recovered from leaving Gumroad."
verbatim_snippet: "2025 was pretty difficult for me (I still haven't recovered from leaving Gumroad), but thanks to the people who still support me, I'm able to keep creating."
notes: Recovery method: Google search index snippet. Author is MaidForge (illustrator). Ran Gumroad memberships (41 ratings visible on residual Gumroad page). Left Gumroad in 2025; migrated supporters to own website. Reason for leaving not stated in this post — likely related to adult content/moderation policy but cannot be confirmed from this source alone.
